image_brief: Google AI agents autonomously rewriting production server code inside a real data center, outperforming human engineers

slides.headline: GOOGLE AI JUST BEAT HUMANS AT CODING BY 2.7X
slides.kicker: ALREADY IN PRODUCTION, NOT A DEMO

caption:
Google's AI rewrote 32,000 lines of hand-tuned code and made it run 2.7x faster than the engineers' version.

Google's Gemini 4 Argon agents migrated over 800,000 lines of real production code and freed over 300 terabytes of server memory, without a human writing a single line. Then they took Google's own video decoder, replaced every line of its hand-optimized code, and the AI rewrite ran 2.7 times faster than what the engineers built. The video output came out identical. If you're studying software engineering, the thing that should keep you up tonight just shipped.

AI isn't assisting engineers anymore. It's finishing months of real work in production, with better results than the humans who wrote it first. Every software team now has to reckon with an AI that can redo what took engineers months, faster.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: kimmonismus on X, Google
